scope.summary: Implement object styles as the layout counterpart of text styles carrying the full frame-formatting surface named in MT-168; applying an object style sets fitting (MT-162), text wrap (MT-157), anchoring (MT-158), effects targeting (MT-164), and export tagging (MT-171) in one operation. Table and cell styles MUST format tables and cells declaratively; a table style references its component cell styles and applying it cascades through the table. All over the shared StudioStyleRegistry; consumed by MT-155/MT-162/MT-167.
acceptance_criteria: object style sets fitting/wrap/anchor/effects/export-tag in one op; table style cascades through cell styles
proof_targets: one-operation object-style application runtime; table-style cascade test
expected_tests: live: applying one object style sets fitting+wrap+anchoring+effects+export-tag together
test: table style cascades through component cell styles across the table

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Object, table & cell styles

risk_if_missed: Object/table/cell formatting not reusable in one operation; declarative table styling absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
